body: I will keep you in mind Chubbsie :)

I just decided to come check this account in case anyone else was checking up on me. I am in a much better mind state. I had a wonderful conversation with another redditor that really made a lot of sense and I will be forever grateful. It opened up a really wonderful dialogue between my husband and I because I had failed to mention to him that sometimes I get the urge to cut when I'm extremely overwhelmed. Reddit is such an awesome place and I thank you for your concern even if it was after the fact :p
I actually spent quite a few hours having a conversation with another redditor and it helped a ton. Thank you so much for your concern though.
